actions.label: List Documents
actions.description: See the Markdown documents Ouro MD can reach.
actions.agent: Lists the Markdown documents in the folders Ouro MD serves, with name, folder, path and when each was modified. Changes nothing.

query.label: Search
query.description: Words to match against names and folders; leave it out to list everything.

documents.label: Documents
documents.description: One line per document: its name, two spaces, then its path. Empty when none match.

actions.label: Get Markdown Document
actions.description: Get the Markdown of a document, including unsaved edits.
actions.agent: Returns a document's Markdown as saved, 20000 characters at a time; a longer document says where the next page starts. Changes nothing.

document.label: Document
document.description: The document: its name as list_documents shows it ("Plan"), or its path, absolute or relative to a served folder. Leave it out for the document on screen.

from.label: From
from.description: The character (counted as a person sees letters) to start at, for the next page of a long document; 0 when left out.

markdown.label: Markdown
markdown.description: The document's Markdown, or the page that starts at from.

length.label: Length
length.description: The whole document's length in characters.

next.label: Next
next.description: Where the next page starts; absent when this page is the end.

actions.label: Add to Markdown Document
actions.description: Add Markdown to the end of a document, as one undoable edit.
actions.agent: Adds Markdown to the end of a document as a new paragraph and saves it; an open Ouro MD window picks up the change. It changes only this file. Returns the outcome, checked by reading the document back.

markdown.label: Markdown
markdown.description: The Markdown to add, such as "- [ ] Call the harbor master".

document.label: Document
document.description: The document: its name as list_documents shows it, or its path. Leave it out for the document on screen.

state.label: State
state.description: done, or uncertain when the text read back differs beyond Markdown formatting.

checked.label: Checked
checked.description: How the result was checked: the document was read back after the edit.

next.label: Next
next.description: The call to make next, when the outcome is uncertain.

actions.label: Replace Markdown Document
actions.description: Replace a document's whole Markdown, as one undoable edit, after you confirm.
actions.agent: Replaces a document's whole Markdown. It overwrites every line, so it asks first: without confirmed: true it changes nothing and says what to ask the person. Send confirmed: true only after the person has said yes.

markdown.label: Markdown
markdown.description: The Markdown that becomes the document's whole text.

document.label: Document
document.description: The document: its name as list_documents shows it ("Plan"), or its path, absolute or relative to a served folder.

confirmed.label: Confirmed
confirmed.description: true once the person has confirmed replacing this document; leave it out to ask.

state.label: State
state.description: done, uncertain when the text read back differs beyond Markdown formatting, or needs-human until the person confirms.

summary.label: Summary
summary.description: What happened, or what to ask the person, in a sentence.

next.label: Next
next.description: The call to make once the person has said yes, or after an uncertain edit.

actions.label: Open Markdown Document
actions.description: Open a Markdown document in Ouro MD.
actions.agent: Opens a Markdown document in Ouro MD, so the person sees it. Changes no text.

document.label: Document
document.description: The Markdown document to open, by name or path.
